registered_scope: Two pinned public Python repositories; exact static local-import edges, reverse dependent closure, repository-wide coverage state, and fail-closed impact status.
registration_rule: Expected edges, changed paths, coverage and impact states, corpus commit/tree/archive hashes, metrics, and thresholds are frozen in this committed registration before the runner is executed. Do not edit this file in response to results; failures remain failures.
expected_results_source: Manual source inspection of the exact pinned commits using tracked-file listings and import statements. Expected edges are only statically resolvable repository-local module edges under the analyzer documented exact-name model. No candidate analyzer output was used to construct these expected values.

metric_definitions.edge_precision: TP/(TP+FP), with 1.0 if both sets empty
metric_definitions.edge_recall: TP/(TP+FN), with 1.0 if expected set empty
metric_definitions.dependent_precision: intersection(predicted, expected)/len(predicted), with 1.0 if predicted set empty
metric_definitions.dependent_recall: intersection(predicted, expected)/len(expected), with 1.0 if expected set empty
metric_definitions.coverage_state_accuracy: Fraction of cases where coverage_complete_for_all_repository_source exactly equals the registered boolean
metric_definitions.impact_status_accuracy: Fraction of cases where impact.status exactly equals the registered status
metric_definitions.case_pass: All four precision/recall values equal 1.0, exact edge and dependent sets, and exact coverage and impact states

execution_constraints: Do not execute code from the analyzed repositories.
Do not modify the pinned repositories.
Verify HEAD, tree, clean working tree, and git-archive SHA-256 before every case.
Analyzer output is written outside the analyzed repository.
Do not change thresholds or expected values after execution.
corpus_archive_sha256_algorithm: SHA-256 of the git archive --format=tar HEAD bytes from the pinned, clean checkout.
limitations: Only two repositories; not representative of all project layouts or languages.
Static import edges are not runtime call/data-flow edges.
Exact-name module resolution does not model src-layout package installation.
A pass does not establish source authenticity beyond the pinned Git commit/tree and measured archive hash.
